findings.current: If I hit you, it seems like it’d hurt too much.
findings.rationale: Jin asks to hit Jeok because Jin expects being hit himself would hurt.
findings.replacement: If you hit me, it’d hurt too much.
findings.source: 제가 맞으면 너무 아플 것 같아서.

findings.current:
Because then, everything would start to feel inevitable.

And another person’s sacrifice and death must never be treated as inevitable.
findings.defect: Changes the danger of growing accustomed to deaths into a claim about whether deaths are inevitable.
findings.rationale: 당연해져 버릴 and 당연해져서는 안 되는 refer to treating sacrifice and death as ordinary or expected, continuing the thought about never getting used to them.
findings.replacement:
Because then, I’d start taking everything for granted.

And another person’s sacrifice and death must never become something I take for granted.
findings.source:
그렇게 된다면 모든 것이 당연해져 버릴 테니까.

그리고 누군가의 희생과 죽음은, 결코 당연해져서는 안 되는 종류의 것이니까.

findings.current: Gaettongi, a divine general descended upon this land in answer to Heaven’s will, has arrived!
findings.defect: Uses Gaettongi instead of the established name Gaettong.
findings.rationale: The glossary maps 개똥이 to Gaettong; the final 이 here is not part of the established English name.
findings.replacement: Gaettong, a divine general descended upon this land in answer to Heaven’s will, has arrived!

summary: Three actionable findings: one reversed action, one altered moral distinction, and one glossary mismatch.
